verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect support. Prompts can be versioned with a choice of which version is live, which is effectively version selection and rollback for prompts. Gates have an emergency disable switch, and the CLI and Console API let you manage gates and experiments from CI/CD pipelines, so configs could be versioned in your own repo. Nothing documents versioning, review or rollback of automations themselves. Missing for 10: native change history/versioning for automations or configs, review/approval workflows, one-click rollback to a prior automation version, independent or hands-on corroboration.
